# Local icon sources

UI: lucide-static **1.66.0**, ISC, https://lucide.dev / https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide . Selected canonical SVG nodes are embedded in ../icons.js. external-link.svg is the canonical Lucide asset used by external links. No icon CDN or runtime package is loaded.

Brands: simple-icons **16.36.0**, CC0, https://simpleicons.org / https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons . Only the 21 brand SVGs referenced in ../company-icons.js are bundled. A ticker and company name represent every brand absent from this release; no substitute logo is invented. Brand assets retain their upstream paths and titles. Brand trademarks remain with their owners; see SIMPLE-ICONS-DISCLAIMER.md.

StockLens' own existing logo is retained. LUCIDE-LICENSE and SIMPLE-ICONS-LICENSE are distributed alongside these sources. This documentation and licenses are source artifacts, not public HTTP routes.
